scope: Point-in-time comparison of semiconductor operations. Read the limits per capability. Baseline IDs include classes, methods, tests, stubs, duplicates and context.

method.target_hash: SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 Python source bytes from the first decorator through the definition end, including original line endings and final newline when present. Line is the declaration line.
method.source_hash: Copied immutable baseline SHA-256 values. Missing source body hashes retain null. Original locators, including notebook cell index, remain in each row.
method.relationship: All capability_refs identify scoped behavioral correspondence or separately tested replacement intent. None is a claim of full source-function equivalence.
method.confidence: High for recorded identities and the tested contracts within their stated limits. Medium for source-to-capability interpretation. No assessment of commercial device accuracy.
method.target_index: Full paths are repository-relative. Target IDs refer to entries in targets. Test, view, browser and target files resolve through files.
method.exclusions: Historical Qt, test references, generic systems and incomplete or defective reference bodies receive separate dispositions. No source was executed to infer equivalence.

gate.scope: Gate charge, piecewise RC/Miller intervals, gate current and turn-on/off timing in SI units.
gate.limit: Charge and drive assumptions give a lumped estimate. Drain voltage, ringing and switching energy require more device data.

dpt.scope: Two-pulse schedule, runnable generic LTspice netlist and windowed event integrals.
dpt.limit: Only the declared channel-current and voltage integral enters energy. External capacitance heat and calibrated vendor accuracy remain unknown.

measurement.scope: Import supplied CSV, LTspice RAW and measurement logs. Select source traces, windows, signs, units and step.
measurement.limit: 8 MB, 100000 samples, 500000 cells and 10000 log records. Undeclared signals, conditions or temperature remain unknown.

parameters.scope: Fit a bounded linear voltage/current model, decompose or integrate capacitance, evaluate signed slew and explicit parameter estimates.
parameters.limit: Fixed conditions, finite samples and declared selection bound each estimate. A fitted line does not calibrate a commercial part.

tables.scope: Conditioned measured tables, bounded interpolation and selected separable energy estimates.
tables.limit: Generic model training, feature maps, arbitrary extrapolation, validation of ENCO-trained coefficients and a universal surrogate are outside this evidence.

biela.scope: Christen–Biela inductive switching energies, phase partitions, recovery, sweeps and convergence diagnostics.
biela.limit: Physical applicability depends on declared input regime. Fixtures establish equation behavior. Switching ringing and manufacturer accuracy lack measurements.

extract.scope: Fit transfer curves or bounded output slices and derive charge-control parameters from reverse-recovery test conditions.
extract.limit: The source drain voltage, temperature, diode test current and slew remain separate from the model operating point. Fit residuals remain visible.

wave.scope: Integrate signed conduction across knots with cubic power segments. Apply independent turn-on/off energy at pre-edge samples.
wave.limit: Only declared branches, conditions and events participate. Omitted components make full power unavailable.

spectrum.scope: Current statistics, uniformly sampled spectra, linked cursor and time range, and component watts.
spectrum.limit: Time and frequency axes have separate meanings. General series arithmetic and arbitrary resampling are outside this interface.

map.scope: Conditioned energy slices with recorded points, bounded current interpolation, and optional four-corner estimate.
map.limit: Missing or ambiguous corners exclude an estimate. Free-form XYZ import, arbitrary 3D gridding and operating-condition extrapolation have no equivalence proof.

grid.scope: Finite configuration-by-operating-point evaluation, weights, stable ranking, partial coverage and linked result views.
grid.limit: 32 configurations, 64 points, 256 pairs, 4 MB input and 24 MB output. A failed positive-weight pair prevents a full mean.

assembly.scope: Parallel banks, signed composite devices and reverse conduction envelopes with declared current sharing.
assembly.limit: Identical-device and symmetry assumptions require selection. A composite characteristic does not model arbitrary unequal die currents.

thermal.scope: Foster impedance, exact polynomial heating and event impulses, steady paths, electrothermal iteration and current screening.
thermal.limit: Initial temperature, thermal network and physical owner require declaration. Known-component heat needs explicit acknowledgment.

converters.scope: Twelve revisioned role mappings and a custom mapping aggregate measured waveforms or declared held envelopes.
converters.limit: Supply role signals, symmetry and source omissions. These mappings postprocess semiconductor losses. Full magnetic and circuit operating-point design lacks evidence.

fom.scope: Source-specific catalog candidate and metric populations, quote cohorts, relative normalization, Pareto ties and linked panels.
fom.limit: An absent price can exclude one objective while voltage and current remain visible. Currency, historical tier, and source identity limit each price comparison.

sources.scope: CSV and OOXML source preview, units, cached results, errors, links, coefficients, mappings, version diff and snapshot transfer.
sources.limit: Stored cells, macros and connections are archival evidence. No arbitrary formula, VBA or Power Query is executed.

digitizer.scope: Calibrate independent image axes and transform selected image pixels to physical coordinates with source provenance.
digitizer.limit: Static PNG/JPEG only. No automatic recognition or perspective correction. Declared units and data meaning remain the operator’s responsibility.

mat.scope: Preview MAT5 and supported Octave text, archive source bytes and fields, explicitly map scData, and export semantic MAT5 with loss diagnostics.
mat.limit: Other workspace schemas have preview/archive support. HDF5, object and function workspaces have no semantic conversion.

plecs.scope: Read all PLECS packages, repeated blocks and conditions. Preserve metadata and export source-backed or explicitly selected core tables.
plecs.limit: Formula metadata can be preserved without evaluating it. Generic solver acceptance, opaque model semantics and absent ratings remain unverified.

compare.scope: Compare recorded panels and explicit static-duty estimates. Expose missing source power and thermal values.
compare.limit: Efficiency requires supplied output power and complete device loss. Commercial power density, universal similarity score and an unconstrained optimizer lack supporting data.

core.scope: Use exact conditions to linearize bounded signed channel data and update the public working point atomically.
core.limit: Exact knots use the right derivative except at the upper endpoint. Missing, ambiguous and out-of-range records reject.

native.scope: Serialize native JSON, numeric MAT5 with complete core_json, and condition-selected Gecko switch SCL with evidence manifest.
native.limit: Gecko requires seven explicit conditions. Unmodeled diode forward recovery, general calibrated SPICE and Simulink block generation are unsupported. CSV is a ratings summary.

gate-sizing.scope: Size total gate-loop resistance for a supplied maximum Miller slew, drive rails, Crss minimum and plateau interval.
gate-sizing.limit: The maximum resistance required over that interval sets the minimum total resistance for the target slew. Driver and internal resistance must be accounted for to select an external part. Constant capacitance is a selected estimate.

workbook-indices.scope: Derive ten named thermal, switching, resistance and cooling metrics from recorded or explicitly mapped inputs. The selected thermal convention uses the shared current-screening calculation.
workbook-indices.limit: The 100 °C boundary and constant conduction model describe an estimate. Missing or erroneous recovery, ambiguous area units or undeclared quote context exclude the affected metrics. No arbitrary formula execution.

rg-energy.scope: Evaluate bounded switching-energy curves at gate resistance, or invert data for one unique gate-resistance crossing. Python-only public helpers.
rg-energy.limit: Supply the device and switching branch, one physical context, exact fixed current or gate resistance, and bounded recorded coverage. No separate browser operation. A target-energy solution has a different contract from inverse Miller slew sizing.

supplemental_sources.scope: 310 stored-value rows use minimum normalization. The source does not establish their part-row lineage.
Source relative-cost scatter uses a logarithmic y-axis. The current Pareto front adds a dominance calculation.
Five stored Power Query definitions and three loaded tables. A supplied source snapshot replaces machine-specific refresh.
Two substantive VBA procedures in five project modules. Static extraction reads 59 stored links independently of 63 GetURL formula cells.
Switching-energy/current coefficients have units J/A. Source voltage, current, temperature and cache remain visible.
Explicit source-dependent thermal path, power budget and current screening. Additional price-normalized ratios need their own declared source assumptions.
Select bounded temperature input or an explicit resistance estimate. Source-identity, gate bias and fit limits qualify the result.
Original rows, formulas and errors remain available. Ten named derivations require explicit thermal, switching, area and quote evidence. Original formula/cached cells remain distinct.
Mixed Python/Octave notebook. The turn-on discussion supplies scientific intent. Cells refer to a plateau before definition and no complete turn-off calculation follows its heading.
Stored market-survey panels support source/panel identity. The archived notebook does not compute a general nondominated front. The current front is calculated independently.
The source examples size total gate resistance. Separate row-specific energy multipliers lack a general calibration basis.
This script assigns a particular thermal interface value. The current workflow requires supplied path and area assumptions.
Historical pack preparation uses explicit parts and parallel counts. No universal device-sizing rule follows from those examples.
The source script draws on recorded switching data. Current imports and maps require explicit signals, units, conditions and energy convention.
A source example applies lumped gate capacitance and particular empirical scaling assumptions. Current charge/timing calculations require declared model inputs.
